comments.post_title: IELTS Speaking Advice: get to the point
comments.text: Hi Ha Thu, I disagree with 'wasting words' - examiners know that students learn phrases to put on the front of their answers, and they are not impressed by these phrases. You will get a better score if you focus on answering in a natural, direct way (like you would in your own language).
